description: Draft an email to a broker or carrier pushing back on a truckload quote, using the market benchmark for the lane and this week's market direction. Set want_counter to true to also draft a counter-offer. If no benchmark is given, the national all-in rate for the equipment is used. Included with FreightFA Pro and Desk accounts.

benchmark_per_mile.description: All-in market benchmark in $/mi (e.g. from estimate_truckload_rate), or null to use the national rate.

quoted_total.description: The all-in quote being pushed back on, in dollars.

name: draft_pushback_email
title: Draft an email pushing back on a freight quote
